ModMetaData.name: Carry Policy
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
Carry policies for RimWorld 1.6.
Configure named carry policies (like vanilla drug policies) that specify which items colonists keep in their inventory. Assign them per colonist in the Assign tab.
Features:
- Vanilla-style policy management dialog: create / duplicate / rename / default policies, left list + right two-column editor (carry list and pickable items with category browsing, search and multi-select). - Anything that can enter a pawn inventory can be carried: meals, nutrient paste, milk, drugs, medicine, resources... - Nutrient paste is fetched from paste dispensers (one meal per trip). - Food amounts are measured in portions: one portion is what an average adult eats in one meal (0.9 nutrition, about 13.5 hours). Pawns with faster hunger (modded races, genes...) automatically carry proportionally more items. - Pawns top up their inventory automatically and never drop or haul away items covered by their policy.
Mod published in MIT license at https://github.com/lisanhu/rimworld-RimModNotes.git Folder name 81-CarryPolicy
